Appointment Calendar Screen
        Appointment calendar screen enables you to view, edit and manage the inbound appointment schedules for every dock of a warehouse.
         
        Features of this screen
        
            View appointments for all dock doors of a warehouse in the screen.
            View the calendar in two ways: Day and 7 Days view.Day: view appointments for a 24 hour time line.7 Day : view appointment for a 7 day time line.
            Preview the appointment details.
            Edit the start and end time for an existing appointment.
        
        Related Topics...
        Creating/Viewing Receipt Appointments
        
        Using the Receipt Insight Screen
        
        Receiving Process Summary
        
         
        Field Descriptions.
            
                Today Button
                
                Day Button
                
                7 days Button
                
                Previous  < Button
                
                Next > Button
                
                Appointment Date and Time
                
                Dock Doors
                
            
        
         
        The following is detailed in this document
        Viewing scheduled appointments
        
        Previewing an appointment
        
        Viewing 7 Days appointments schedule
        
        Editing an appointment
        
        Creating a new appointment
        
        Customizing the Appointment calendar
        
         
         
        Viewing Scheduled Appointments 
         
        The Appointment calendar enables you to manage inbound receipts for the warehouse. Read  create an appointment for more details.
         
        
            To view scheduled appointments, navigate to Menu >> Receiving >> Appointment Calendar, 
            
                The names of the receiving dock doors are listed under Dock Doors. The corresponding appointment for the door is displayed in the calendar.
            
            
                Toggle the Day and 7 Days buttons to view the following 
                
                    Day: to view scheduled appointments for a single day.
                    7 Days: to view scheduled appointment for a 7 day time line.
                
            
            
                Click each scheduled appointment on the calendar to view the details such as dock door, carrier, trailer ID, start and end time.
            
            
                Note: The scheduled appointments are refreshed on changing the selected warehouse. The date and time line on the calendar does not change by refreshing the screen.
            
        
         Follow the steps to change the warehouse.
        
            
                In the navigation bar, select the drop-down list to view all the warehouse available for the system
                 
            
            
                Select the warehouse of your choice. The screen is refreshed with the scheduled appointments for the selected warehouse.
            
        
        When the appointment calendar is opened for Today, then  calendar shows the time line for the current time offset by one hour. For example, if the current time is 10 am, then the left most time in calendar will be 9 am.
        This feature works when we click Today button from either the Day or 7 Day view. This offset time is configurable in metadata in SDK. Refer to the SCALE SDK documentation for more information.
         
        Previewing an Appointment
         
        Each scheduled appointment details can be previewed 
        
            
                Click the appointment in the calendar. 
                 
            
            
                The pop-up window displays the appointment details such as Door Dock, Trailer ID, Carrier, Start and End time. 
                 
            
            
                You can  edit all above field values using the Scheduled Appointment screen.
            
        
        Field Descriptions..
            
                Receiving Appointment Schedule Screen
                
                Schedule
                Carrier Name
                
                End Date Time
                
                Receiving Dock
                
                Start Date Time
                
                Trailer ID
                
            
        
         
        Viewing 7 Day Appointment Schedule
        The calendar screen has the ability to display appointments for 7 days from the current date.
        
            
                Click 7 Days button to toggle from Day to 7 Days view.
                 
            
            
                The appointment schedule for next 7 days from the current date is displayed on the calendar.
                 
            
            
                Scroll the calendar from left to right using the horizontal slider to view all the days in the 7 days view.
                 
            
            
                To view the next 7 days and previous 7 days appointment schedules, click the < and > buttons respectively.
            
        
        For example:
        
        Today’s/ Current Date is: June 1. 
        Click 7 Days button.
        Calendar displays the appointment schedule from June 1 to June 7.
        Click the > button to view the appointments from June 8 to June 14
        Click the < button to view the appointments schedule from May 25 to May 31.
         
         
        Editing an Appointment
        You can edit an existing appointment by following the steps:
         
        
            
                Select the appointment in the calendar to view the details in the pop-up window.
                 
            
            
                Click Edit Appointment button to view the Receiving Appointment Scheduling screen.
                 
            
            
                Change the Start date time/ End date time as required.
                 
            
            
                Click Save. View the modified appointment in the Appointment Calendar screen.
                .
            
        
        Note: The button in details window will be Edit Appointment or View Appointment based on user security permission. In case its View Appointment, then you have permission only to view and not to edit the appointment.
        See the topic Creating/Viewing Receipt Appointments for more information.
         
        Creating a new Appointment
        A new appointment can be created in two ways
         
        Using the Actions - New button
         
        
            
                Click Actions >> New to view the  Receiving Appointment Scheduling screen.
                 
            
            
                Enter the Start date time and  End date time. 
                 
            
            
                Select the Receiving Dock from the drop-down list.
                 
            
            
                Enter the Receipt id in the text box. Alternatively you can  search for receipt ID in the lookup window.
                .
            
            
                Click Save and view the appointment created in the Appointment Calendar screen.
                 
            
        
        Selecting the appointment time line.
        
            
                Select the required dock door and select the time duration for appointment by cursory action of mouse. Click Actions >> New to view the  Receiving Appointment Scheduling screen.
                 
            
            
                The selected appointment start and end date time will be displayed. If required, modify the  Start date time and  End date time.
                 
            
            
                Enter the Receipt id in the text box. Alternatively, you can search for receipt ID in the lookup window.
                .
            
            
                Click Save and view the appointment created in the Appointment Calendar screen.
            
        
        See the topic Creating/Viewing Receipt Appointments for more information.
         
        Customizing the Appointment Calendar
         
        Customization of appointment calendar enables you to modify features to your business requirements.  Read the SCALE SDK documentation to do the following customization.
         
        
            
                How to: 
                
                    Customize the Appointment Calendar Page Appointment Preview Fields
                    Customize the Appointment Calendar Page Appointment Colors
                    Customize the Calendar Event Preview
                
                 
            
            
                Appointment Calendar Events SQL - Modify Exit Point
                 
            
            
                Additional information for the FullCalendar control is found under the following topics
                
                    Supported Control Properties
                    Supported Screen Controls
